param_input_item.param_description: Field size: a scalar for a square field, or a [rows cols] vector.
Number of feature points per axis (default 8).
Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: A rows-by-cols matrix whose entries are the 1-based index of the nearest feature point.

description.p: Build a Voronoi partition: every pixel is labeled with the index of the nearest feature point of a jittered grid. Unlike tessera.worley (which returns a distance), this returns region identifiers, convenient for biome maps, mosaics and flat-shaded cells.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: R = tessera.voronoi(256, 14, 1); imagesc(R); axis image off; colormap(hsv(196))
